name: ProPublica Congress API
tagline: Congressional members, bills, votes, and committees via ProPublica data layer
description: ProPublica Congress API provides structured access to U.S. congressional data including members, bills, votes, committees, and statements. Long a popular third-party layer over legislative data, it is widely used for vote tracking, member lookups, and bill research. Authentication uses an API key header; endpoints return JSON. Verify current operational status and free-tier limits against official docs before production use.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header; historically self-serve signup (verify current availability).

use_cases: look up current senators or representatives for a state
get recent votes for a member of Congress
fetch bill details and cosponsors by bill ID
list recent bills introduced in a chamber
retrieve committee membership for a Congress session
